title: video — JPEG Video Frame
description: Client sends a JPEG-encoded camera frame asynchronously from audio. Approximately 1 fps. Server acknowledges with ai_video_ack.

frame_id.description: Monotonically increasing video frame sequence number. Used for ai_video_ack pairing and loss detection (gap > 1).

turn_id.description: Capture-turn identifier (values start at 1). Client increments it every time the camera is opened, the front/back lens is switched, or screen capture starts. When the server observes a change, it treats this frame as the first frame of a new turn and immediately starts an LLM/TTS turn (without waiting for ASR). Absent or 0 = feature disabled; behavior unchanged (legacy).

text.description: Optional user instruction accompanying this frame (e.g. "描述图片内容"). When present and non-empty, the server immediately runs a dialog turn with this text (no ASR turn needed) and the frame is consumed as that turn's image. Absent/empty → current behavior (frame only buffered).
